methodology.summary: A 2006–2025 historical window assembled only from public USGS price tables. Every point preserves chemical form, product purity, source, temporal basis and benchmark segment. Early supplier quotes and unspecified annual price tables must not be presented as a continuous annual-average metal-price series.
chartRules: Draw each segment separately and do not connect segments with different benchmark, purity, averaging or delivery basis.
Do not draw a line across a missing year, even when neighboring points share a segment ID.
Show supplier/package versus reported-price versus annual-average basis in tooltips and legends.
Use USD per kilogram of oxide. Never relabel as metal price.
2025 points are USGS estimates published in 2026, not current quotes.
A missing value must be null with an explicit missingReason and must create a visual gap; never interpolate. The four selected oxide series have no missing year in this compiled 20-year window.
Do not calculate a CAGR across a benchmark segment boundary.

methodology.revisionPolicy: Prefer later verified prior-year entries where available. Selected recent 2021–2025 values come from MCS 2026, including its rounding and revisions. 2015–2018 Nd/Dy/Tb averages use MCS 2020; 2019 uses MCS 2021; Pr uses the cited revised MYB table entries.
methodology.chemistryCaveat: The USGS price rows name the oxide but generally do not specify its molecular formula. Oxide-to-contained-element stoichiometric normalization is not a metal-market quote: reduction yield, conversion charges, impurities, alloying, financing and delivery costs are additional.
methodology.calculatorRecommendation: Use user-supplied elemental metal or alloy purchase prices and measured or supplier-supplied mass fractions. Grade names such as N42 or N42SH do not provide a unique Nd/Pr/Dy/Tb recipe. Report elemental raw-material exposure per kg of magnet and price-change sensitivity, not a finished magnet price.
